reason: I'm on about 16k a month and grab a Monster or Red Bull almost every day, so paying 55 for a smaller can than a big Monster just doesn't add up. And I can't even pick it up at Albert or the petrol station on my way, I'd have to order it online or find a café.
objection: It's 10 crowns more than a Red Bull for less drink, and it's not where I actually buy my energy drinks.
would_change_my_mind: If it was in the fridge at Albert or Tesco for around 40-45 CZK, I'd try it on a yoga day instead of a Monster.
